text:
Elaine S (Sales): Hey team — AcmeCorp asks for SOC 2 excerpt + ISO artifacts for the POC. They also want a signed pen-test attestation and a list of staging IPs. Deadline: next Friday EOD. Can we confirm what we can hand off and whether VPC + KMS separation changes the Dedicated quote?

Raj (SE): Quick checklist from my side: SOC2 report excerpt (redacted), ISO27001 scope statement, one-page pen-test attestation, network diagram, staging creds / IP ranges, SSO/SCIM onboarding notes. We can provide redacted artifacts and a pen-test letter template. For pricing: VPC + dedicated KMS usually adds ~20% to the committed Dedicated monthly — will verify exact numbers.

Marta (Security): @Elaine we can sign the standard pen-test attestation. Need the customer's legal contact + signing authority. Important: we only provide attestation of testing and remediation posture, we don't hand over raw vulnerability findings. If Acme insists on raw reports, that's an extra legal review.

Frank (Ops): We can spin up a staging window and hand over a small CIDR + jumpbox host. We also provide presigned upload links for evidence. Note: if they request reserved burst capacity for the POC, that will change the billing model for that period.

Elaine S (Sales): Can someone paste the pen-test attestation template and the presign example? Also confirm whether we have a canonical dataroom link or should we use S3 presigned URLs.

Raj (SE): Pen-test attestation (one page) example below: 

```
Redwood Inference, Inc. attests that on [DATE] an external penetration test was performed against our production and staging inference services by [3rd-party vendor]. Based on the scope agreed with the customer, Redwood Inference confirms that:
- the engagement tested the public-facing surfaces and designated staging endpoints;
- critical/high findings were remediated or mitigated prior to customer onboarding;
- Redwood provides attestations of testing and remediation status; detailed findings and raw reports are not provided without a separate legal agreement.
Signed,
Redwood Inference Security Team
```

Raj (SE): Presign example (Ops will manage uploads):

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/acmecorp/poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 604800
```

Marta (Security): Add: "If the customer requires HSM-backed keys (external KMS/HSM), that triggers an enterprise review and ~2 week procurement lead time."

Frank (Ops): For network diagram we provide a redacted architecture + a list of staging IPs: 13.32.120.0/28 for jumpbox and 13.32.121.0/28 for test agents (example only). Exact IPs allocated at time of staging window.

Elaine S (Sales): Thanks — I'll ask Acme for the legal signer and whether they need raw findings. Also ask if they'd prefer the dataroom or presigned S3. Targeting internal delivery Thu EOD so we can get their security team review on Friday.

Raj (SE): I'll update the Dedicated quote with the VPC+KMS line (+~20%) and post a PDF back here in ~2h.

Marta (Security): FYI if they request SOC2 Type II (full report) we can provide a cover letter and redacted sections, but full report access requires an NDA/dataroom control.

evidence-bot: New ticket created: EVIDENCE-12345 — "AcmeCorp POC: SOC2/ISO artifacts + pen-test attestation". Assigned: Raj (SE), Marta (Security), Frank (Ops).

Elaine S (Sales): Perfect. I'll confirm signer + dataroom preference with Acme and post back. :thumbsup:
